decisions.decision:
The deck is built, all 218 slides pass build.mjs and probe.mjs, and it is live. The only step left is Adi's review. Before he looks, the agent should:
1) Merge branch series-deck-finish into main on adisuja/3-day-tantra-ai-revops-workshop and push. The owner rule is that main holds the latest work, and the branch currently only has main merged into it, not the other way round.
2) On main, rerun deck export-cards, build.mjs and probe.mjs, and check that the published copy matches.
3) Republish with publish.sh only if the deck output changed, and update the ?v= link in evidence and needs_from_owner.
Keep the status at review and put one ask to Adi. Leave the Group B defaults in DECISIONS_FOR_ADI.md as they are. They belong under T-484 and are not part of this review. Keep the named build gaps on their own tasks.
decisions.why: The 2026-10-22 handoff shows the deck live at ?v=9ac222b and probes clean, but series-deck-finish is not merged into main. Owner decisions on 2026-10-06 say main must hold the latest. Under orchestrator-autonomy, Adi's only remaining part is the review.
